translation:
Also, the bark governs vomiting and retching with stomach reversal (吐逆胃反), removes the three worms (去三蟲), and [treats] heat sores of children (小兒熱瘡), heat and vexation of the body and head (身頭熱煩), and erosive sores (蝕瘡). Bathe in its decoction, and also apply the powdered [bark] as a compress. The tender leaves...

The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 梓白皮 (zǐbáipí), flavor bitter, cold.
